Home / Quality & responsibility
QUALITY & RESPONSIBILITY

Quality is more than a final number.

Trustworthy information depends on disciplined handling, suitable assessment and communication that makes technical findings understandable.

THE ESSENTIAL PILLARS

Confidence lives in the details.

Quality is expressed through the choices made throughout a process, not merely in the appearance of a final report.

01

Identity

Know precisely which material a result concerns.

02

Suitability

Match the question and examination approach.

03

Traceability

Keep relevant observations and references connected.

04

Interpretation

Explain only what the evidence supports.

05

Confidentiality

Treat specimen and enquiry information with care.

06

Responsibility

Make expectations and limitations clear.

FROM SAMPLE TO FINDING

Traceability connects every step.

An informative record links the question and specimen to the observations made. Clear reference numbers, appropriate handling and method context help keep conclusions meaningful.

Explore sample handling ↗
RESPONSIBLE INTERPRETATION

Disciplined thinking. Understandable results.

The purpose of assessment is not to produce more information than necessary but to address a real question with context. Results must stay within the limits of what the observations and chosen methods support.

Information about valuable material and those responsible for it deserves considered handling. Clear expectations and communication help all parties understand the intended scope of a result.
